gaps: the case needs a caller who is not a super admin (or lacks a permission), and every run acts as the client's own super-admin buyer — a refusal it expects may legitimately not happen
the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup cannot explicitly configure reopen permission off or verify that the caller is not a Procol employee or super admin.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for only about two minutes.
steps: Wait until the round's bid end time has passed.
The buyer moves the pricing round's bid end time.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to reopen an expired event”, and never with a server error.
